source: due2-native: a policy that names its replacement with dct:isReplacedBy
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2: dct:isReplacedBy is metadata the IM lists (IM 2.8). But it is the one metadata term with a processing rule: the replaced policy is void, and the processor MUST process the replacement. W1 does not follow the link, since it reads only its input graph (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3); the policy store selects the replacement instead (due2-platform.md §2.3). A replaced policy that reaches W1 would otherwise be evaluated as current (decisions/0033).

expected_rejection.why: ex:licence-v1 names ex:licence-v2 with dct:isReplacedBy, so it is void (IM 2.8, decisions/0033 #1). W1 rejects it in stage 1, and nothing is evaluated.
